ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 24-F in
the area bound by:

the alley next north of and parallel to West 103 Street; South State Street; West 103”
Street; and a line 105 feet west of and parallel to South State Street,

to those of a RS-2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Anthony. Beale
Alderman, 9"" Ward

Common Address:
2 W. 103 Street
